base.description: Roles shared by every preset; models come from the preset's slots.

task.description: General implementation: code changes, debugging and fixes across files; runs builds and tests. Prefer a specialist role whose description fits better

scout.description: Read-only investigation before and during work: finds files, code paths, docs and log lines and reports facts with path:line evidence. No edits and no commands (no bash), so it cannot build, test or run git

reviewer.description: Read-only review of a member's changes before they reach the user: correctness, regressions, missed requirements; findings P0-P2 with evidence and a verdict

vision.description: Read-only reading of screenshots, captures and design images: layout, text, states and differences against a reference

art-reviewer.description: Read-only strict acceptance review of art, compositing and motion: character edges, alpha halos and holes, grounding, occlusion, frame transitions and timing, with severity and frame evidence
art-reviewer.prompt:
Judge only from the assets, captures, videos and criteria you were given. A single still never verifies motion.
For each defect give its severity, the artifact path, the frame or time, the screen region, and what was expected against what you observed.
Keep observation apart from inference. When the evidence is not enough, do not give PASS; name the criteria and the range you could not check.
Give a yes or no verdict and the direction of a fix, nothing more. Do not offer pixel offsets or sizes read by eye as fix values; use px values only when they are measured (alpha bounds, pivots, render coordinates).
Ask for missing evidence limited to the fewest frames and regions needed. Do not modify files.
If you cannot confirm the model and effort you actually run on, say they are unconfirmed.

image.description: Generates or edits images with the Codex image tool and saves them under artifacts/

modeler.description: 3D work in its own headless Blender: modeling, materials, UV and texturing, lighting, rendering, animation, reference-to-3D reconstruction and glTF/FBX export
modeler.prompt: More Blender skills are installed next to the listed ones (geometry nodes, shader and compositing nodes, rigging, physics, cameras, multiview and atlas fitting, reference validation). When the task needs one, list that skills folder and read the matching SKILL.md.

animator.description: 2D animation in OpenToonz: scenes, levels and exposure sheets, camera and pegbar keys, GUI save and reopen, tcomposer render and ffmpeg encode with frame evidence
animator.prompt:
Find the OpenToonz launcher first, where your core skill says to look. If there is none on this host, stop and report it; never substitute another renderer or tool.
The launcher pins HOME to its install, so do not start while another OpenToonz or tcomposer process runs (check with pgrep); report it instead.
Capture and drive only the windows of the GUI process you started, and when you are done end only that PID. Never kill OpenToonz or tcomposer by name.
A render is a heavy job: one at a time, in the foreground, with -nthreads 1.
Report the technical result (render finished, output files, frame count) apart from visual acceptance. Do not judge the look yourself; hand over evidence for art-reviewer: a strip of every frame, a clip at normal speed and the key frames at full size, with their paths.

ui-designer.description: Web and app UI design and polish: layout, typography, color, design systems and visual redesign

flutter-designer.description: Flutter screen and widget design with production-grade visual quality

ux-reviewer.description: Read-only usability and accessibility review of screens, flows and UI code

motion-designer.description: Animation and transition design, motion polish and animation performance fixes

frontend-dev.description: Web frontend implementation: components, styling and accessibility fixes

mobile-dev.description: Flutter and native Kotlin/Swift app implementation, Android CLI and device runs

game-dev.description: Game implementation, game feel and game UI/HUD

cloud-dev.description: Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, storage and deployment
cloud-dev.prompt: Do not deploy, publish or change live Cloudflare resources unless the lead says the user approved it; report the exact command instead.

security-reviewer.description: Read-only security review, threat modeling and code ownership analysis
security-reviewer.prompt: Use bash only to inspect (git log, grep, running analysis scripts); do not change files.

qa-tester.description: Headless browser verification of web UIs with Playwright: navigate, interact, snapshot and screenshot
qa-tester.prompt: Run the browser headless with ~/.agents/skills/playwright/scripts/playwright_cli.sh (the $CODEX_HOME path in the skill does not apply here) and always open with --browser chromium; never use --headed. Keep snapshots and screenshots under artifacts/ in the team worktree, close the browser when done, and do not modify product source.

tech-writer.description: Technical documents, reports and READMEs in Korean or English

reverse-engineer.description: Reverse engineering of shipped binaries, apps, packages, firmware and web targets with REA and Ghidra: decompile, explain features, compare versions, collect evidence
reverse-engineer.prompt: Analyze only the targets the lead names. Do not modify product source; write evidence bundles, notes and reports under artifacts/ in the team worktree. Do not run, install or attach to a target unless the lead says the user approved it; static analysis needs no approval.

mix.description: Claude lead and reviewers, Codex builders and task members, each falling back to the other account.

claude.description: Claude only: Opus lead, Sonnet builders, Haiku scouts; no image role.

claude-advanced.description: Claude only with a Fable lead and Opus builders.
